summary: This is a documentation file that introduces 'Contextual Canvas,' a feature designed to help users manage multiple related documents and information in one organized visual workspace. Rather than switching between scattered files and browser tabs, the Canvas intelligently gathers relevant information based on what you're currently doing, keeping everything in sight within your main application.
